description_en: Checks the status of a service in the current cluster, such as whether the service is activated and whether the payment is overdue
description_zh: 检查集群当前的服务状态，例如是否开通服务，是否欠费等
kebab_example: aliyun arms check-service-status --svc-code prometheus --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckServiceStatus
